Package be.stef.rar5.decompress

Class Rar5HuffmanDecoder

java.lang.Object
be.stef.rar5.decompress.Rar5HuffmanDecoder
public class Rar5HuffmanDecoder extends Object
Byte-based Huffman decoder for RAR5.

This decoder supports up to 15-bit codes (RAR5 standard) and uses a two-level decoding strategy:

  • Fast path: Short codes (invalid input: '<'= fastLookupBits) use direct table lookup - O(1)
  • Slow path: Long codes use threshold search to find code length

The decoder must be built with build(byte[], int) before use. It can be reset and rebuilt for each new Huffman table in the stream.

      Creates a new Huffman decoder.
      Parameters:
      maxCodeLength - maximum code length in bits (15 for RAR5)

      public boolean build(byte[] lengths, int buildMode)
      Builds the Huffman tree from code lengths.

      true if build succeeded, false if the code lengths are invalid

    • build

      public boolean build(byte[] lengths, int offset, int buildMode)
      Builds the Huffman tree from code lengths with offset.

      This method constructs both the fast lookup table for short codes and the threshold/offset tables for long codes.

      Parameters:
      lengths - array of code lengths
      offset - starting offset in lengths array
      buildMode - build mode constant (HUFFMAN_BUILD_MODE_*)
      Returns:
      true if build succeeded, false if the code lengths are invalid

    • decode

      public int decode(Rar5BitDecoder bitStream)
      Decodes a symbol from the bit stream.

      Uses fast table lookup for short codes (invalid input: '<'= fastLookupBits) and threshold-based search for longer codes.

      Parameters:
      bitStream - the bit stream to read from
      Returns:
      the decoded symbol

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets the decoder state.

      Clears all tables and marks the decoder as not ready. Must call build(byte[], int) again before decoding.
